about.title: About Me
about.bio_part1: I am <1>Luis Senra Mirabal</1>, a Computer Science Engineer focused on working with Python in data analysis, management, visualization, and web development. I am proficient in working with cutting-edge technologies and adapt easily to different work environments, with huge passion and dedication for the profession, eager to face new challenges to continue growing professionally. I stand out for my analytical capacity, adaptability, and teamwork, fostering collaboration and continuous learning. My goal is to exceed expectations in every project, providing innovative solutions that maintain high standards of quality and efficiency in every line of code.
about.bio_part2: I am passionate about transforming complex problems into scalable systems, always with an eye on code efficiency and data integrity.

items.description: During my university training, I developed a solid foundation in computer science, programming, and software development. The career provided me with deep knowledge in algorithms, data structures, software engineering, and modern web technologies.
